question:
The percentage distribution of the number of tires of different brands produced in a year by a certain factory is shown in the given pie chart. The total number of tires sold is 1350.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/22d7619f26bdacbc4b11dd50e782fd713b17a8ac033ae05f9c38ef1134a42c1b.png] 

What is the difference between the average number of Avon and Firestone tires sold together and the average number of Good year and Dunlop tires sold together?
solution:
**Given:**

Total number of tires sold = 1350

Percentage distribution of tires:

 
• Avon = 21%
 
• Firestone = 14%
 
• Goodyear = 12%
 
• Dunlop = 15%

**Concept and Formula used:**

Average = Total sum of items / Number of items

**Calculation:**

Number of Avon tires sold = 21% of 1350

⇒ Number of Avon tires sold = 0.21 × 1350 = 283.5

Number of Firestone tires sold = 14% of 1350

⇒ Number of Firestone tires sold = 0.14 × 1350 = 189

Number of Goodyear tires sold = 12% of 1350

⇒ Number of Goodyear tires sold = 0.12 × 1350 = 162

Number of Dunlop tires sold = 15% of 1350

⇒ Number of Dunlop tires sold = 0.15 × 1350 = 202.5

Average number of Avon and Firestone tires sold together:

⇒ (283.5 + 189)/2 = 472.5 / 2 = 236.25 

Average number of Goodyear and Dunlop tires sold together:

⇒ (162 + 202.5) / 2 = 364.5/ 2 = 182.25

Difference between the two averages:

⇒ 236.25 - 182.25 = 54

**∴ The difference between the average number of Avon and Firestone tires sold together and the average number of Goodyear and Dunlop tires sold together is 54.**
